questions.q: I'll call you when I ___ home.
questions.why: Після сполучників часу (*when, as soon as, until, before, after*) про майбутнє вживаємо Present Simple, а не *will*: *I'll call you when I get home.* *will* — лише в головній частині.

questions.q: As soon as she ___, we'll start.
questions.why: *as soon as* + Present Simple навіть про майбутнє: *As soon as she comes, we'll start.*

questions.q: I'll wait until you ___.
questions.why: *until* + Present Simple: *I'll wait until you finish.*

questions.q: I'll go out after I ___ my homework. (completion emphasised)
questions.why: Present Perfect після *after / when* підкреслює, що дія спершу завершиться: *after I have done my homework*.

questions.q: While you ___, I'll cook dinner.
questions.why: *while* + тривала дія в майбутньому — Present Continuous: *While you are sleeping, I'll cook dinner.*

questions.q: Which is correct?
options: When I will arrive, I’ll call.
When I would arrive, I’ll call.
questions.why: У підрядному часу *will* не ставимо: *When I arrive, I'll call.*

questions.q: 'If' is used when the event is:
questions.why: *if* — подія невідома, може й не статися.

questions.q: 'When' is used when the event is:
questions.why: *when* — ми очікуємо, що подія точно станеться.

questions.q: I'll tell you the moment she ___ (arrive).
questions.why: *the moment* (щойно) працює як сполучник часу — Present Simple: *the moment she arrives*.

questions.q: Let me know as soon as you ___ (hear) anything.
questions.why: *as soon as* + Present Simple: *as soon as you hear anything*.

questions.q: We'll have dinner when Dad ___ (get) home.
questions.why: *when* + Present Simple: *when Dad gets home*.

questions.q: Don't leave until I ___ (come) back.
questions.why: *until* + Present Simple (*come*) або Present Perfect (*have come*); *get back* — той самий зміст.

questions.q: I'll send it once I ___ (finish) it.
questions.why: *once* + Present Perfect (завершення) або Present Simple.

questions.q: Before you ___, turn off the lights.
questions.why: *before* + Present Simple: *Before you leave, turn off the lights.*

questions.q: I'll be happy when the exams ___ over.
questions.why: *when* + Present Simple: *when the exams are over*.

questions.q: By the time you ___, I'll have cooked dinner.
questions.why: *by the time* + Present Simple: *By the time you get here…*

questions.q: I'll look after the kids while you ___ at work.
questions.why: *while* + Present Simple для стану: *while you are at work*.

answer: I will call you when I arrive
When I arrive I will call you
questions.why: *when* + Present Simple; частини можна поміняти місцями.

answer: As soon as I get home I will cook
As soon as I get home, I will cook
I will cook as soon as I get home
questions.why: *as soon as* + Present Simple.

answer: Wait here until I come back
questions.why: *until* + Present Simple: *until I come back*.
questions.hint: Чекай тут, поки я не повернуся.

questions.q: I don't know when he ___ back.
questions.why: Тут *when* — питальне слово в непрямому питанні («не знаю, коли»), а не сполучник часу, тому майбутнє — *will come*.

questions.q: I'll call you when I ___ the results.
questions.why: *when* — сполучник часу, тому Present Simple: *when I get the results*.

questions.q: By the time you ___, we'll have eaten.
questions.why: Після *by the time* — теперішній час: *By the time you arrive…*

questions.q: She had no sooner sat down ___ the phone rang.
questions.why: *no sooner … than* — «щойно…, як»: *She had no sooner sat down than the phone rang.*

questions.q: I won't sign it ___ I've read it carefully.
questions.why: *not … until* — «не раніше, ніж»: *I won't sign it until I've read it.* *before* і *unless* теж логічно підходять.
